name: HERNIS EX288 Ex PTZ Camera Range
description: The HERNIS EX288 from Spinel’s Crouse?Hinds series combines explosion?protected performance with a compact, lightweight design and a 360° horizontal and 180° vertical field of view, delivering wide?area CCTV coverage from a single mounting point. The dual?camera architecture helps reduce system complexity and installation weight, making the EX288 well suited to space? and weight?restricted hazardous environments.
specs: Ex certified for Zone 1 (gas group IIC) and Zone 21 (dust); Full HD resolution, 33x optical zoom, upgradable to 4K/8MP resolution; Temperature range from -40°C to +70°C; Scratch-proof, tempered glass; Flexible powering options: 30 VAC, 24 VDC, or UPoE

name: Oxalis SF Safe area Dual Imager Fixed Camera Range
description:
This family of industrial fixed thermal cameras offer the ultimate flexibility, with a dual-imager, a wide temperature range of -60°C to +70°C and different thermal lens options to meet your application needs.
Made from 316L Electro polished stainless steel and designed specifically for use in hazardous areas. This hard-wearing and corrosion-resistant fixed camera station is suitable for a variety of applications in onshore, offshore, marine and heavy industrial environments
specs: Electro-polished 316L stainless steel on all welded assemblies; Supply voltage options (24 VAC or 24VDC); Operating temperature from -60?C to +70?C*; Body material: 316L Electro-polished stainless steel on all welded assembles; Fixings material: A4 stainless steel

name: HERNIS PT70 Safe Area Dome Camera Range
description:
The Spinel Crouse-Hinds series offers the PT70 IP dome camera range for safe area surveillance where speed and accuracy are key. The PT70 range offers 360° panoramic rotation and 180° tilt with a speed of 116 degrees per second. 
PT70 cameras are designed to optimise position accuracy and come equipped with auto focus. In poor light conditions these cameras will automatically turn to black and white for optimal image quality. Suitable for indoor or outdoor installation, PT70 safe area dome cameras can be used in most extreme industrial environments.
specs: Flexible powering (30 VAC, 24 VDC, PoE); Stainless steel AISI 316L; Acrylic dome cupola with fastening ring; Multi-cable accomodated; Auto focus with manual override; Automatic day/night function

name: Oxalis SD Safe Area Indoor Optical Dome PTZ Camera Range
description: The Oxalis SD71 safe area indoor optical dome PTZ camera is a highly advanced surveillance station which is designed to perform in demanding environments. It has scratch resistant hard-wearing coating to ensure durability and longevity with minimal maintenance. The SD71 has ethernet over coax (EoC) which uses IP transmissions.
specs: Full HD resolution; Automatic day/night function; Internal cabling; Flexible powering (PoE, 30 VAC, 24 VDC); Scratch resistant hard coating; Auto iris with manual override Steel housing made for fire resistant ceilings; Polycarbonate dome cupola with decorative ring

name: Type 4 Free standing and wall mount panel enclosures
description:
Crouse-Hinds series Type 4 Free-Standing and Wall Mount Panel Enclosures protects against windblown dust and rain, splashing water and hose directed water.  These NEMA industrial enclosures are available in a comprehensive range of sizes, each with various configurations for a multitude of applications.
These exceptionally durable, corrosion resistant enclosures can withstand extreme abuse and exposure to chemicals, water, and severe conditions. They have unique design features, precision manufacturing, and the highest quality materials, making them a premier choice for instrumentation and electrical applications.
specs: Conforms to NEMA Standard for Type 4, Type 12; .312-18 collar studs are provided for mounting optional Premier series panels; Reduced width flange design increases enclosure opening; Utility bracket provides wire management and accessory mounting options; Door opens 170° for easy access; Door has a seamless poured in place gasket

name: Type 3/3R panel enclosures
description: Spinel's B-Line series Type 3 and 3R panel enclosures are used as wiring boxes, junction and pull boxes while helping protect against falling rain, sleet and external ice formation.
specs: UL 50 listed, Type 3R; CSA C22.2 No. 40 certified, Type 3R; Conforms to NEMA standard for Type 3R; Continuous hinge cover options; Single and double-door options

name: Polycarbonate Enclosures
description:
Spinel's B-Line series NEMA Type 4X polycarbonate enclosures are impact-resistant, non-conductive lightweight reinforced polycarbonate.
Designed to house electrical and electronic controls and instruments in harsh indoor and outdoor environments, the polycarbonate enclosures help protect against corrosion, windblown dust and rain, sleet, snow, splashing or hose directed water, UV and flames.
specs: Impact-resistant, non-conductive lightweight reinforced polycarbonate; Multi-directional mounting feet allow mounting flexibility; Thick, robust side wall construction eliminates side wall flexing; Built in DIN rail mounting embosses in the back of the enclosure; Non-metallic or 300 series stainless steel used on all external hardware; Rounded edges reduce build-up of dust and debris

name: EJB Explosionproof Enclosures
description: Crouse-Hinds series EJB explosionproof enclosures are designed for hazardous locations to be used as a junction or pull box, to provide enclosures for slices and taps, and for housing terminal blocks, relays and other electrical devices.  EJB enclosures are globally certified for use in worldwide applications.  They are listed for Class I, Division 1 and Class II, Division 1 hazardous areas, and they also have IECEx and ATEX certifications.
specs: Style C boxes provided with aluminum plate cover; Stainless steel cover bolts (Style C only); External flange design – wide unobstructed cover opening; Enclosures are machined to accept field installed hinges; IEC rated when ordered with ATEX suffix

name: QBX Stainless Steel or Sheet Steel Enclosures
description: Crouse-Hinds series QBX enclosures are ideal for light industrial markets.  Available in stainless steel and painted steel, QBX enclosures are designed for the accommodation of rail mounted terminals or other electro/pneumatic components.  The QBX is user-friendly and offers good access internally.
specs: Fully removable hinged cover, concealed hinges provide 180° opening; Cover mounting, one or two 1/4 turn latches (slot shape); 10 key lockable variations; Mounting through internal holes (Types 3S and 4) or with external lugs (Type 4X); Enclosure – polished 316L stainless steel; polished 304 stainless steel; painted steel

name: STB Stainless Steel or Sheet Steel Enclosures
description:
STB enclosures from Spinel's Crouse-Hinds Division feature a compact and simple design, making them a good fit for the requirements of distribution and lighting junction boxes.  Available in 13 sizes with standard finishes of 316L stainless steel or painted steel.  An IP66 rating makes these enclosures suitable for all environmental conditions.  The stainless steel versions are particularly recommended for use in marine environments or other corrosive applications.
STB enclosures are also available fully assembled as custom-configured and certified terminal boxes.  Options include custom entries, cable glands and plugs with built-in terminals (Ex-e and Ex-i) and other equipment.
specs: Designed to meet the requirement for distribution and lighting junction boxes; 316L stainless steel, together with the high IP rating; Enclosure – polished 316L stainless steel (standard); polished 304 stainless steel; Gasket – foam-in-place silicone (standard)
